RuntimeError: AgentV SDK is unavailable; run npm ci in the checkout or set AGENTV_RUNNER

harness_repair.diagnosis: This is a recurrence of the exact infra failure documented in docs/design/autotrain-cycle-c2-agentv-missing-infra-failure.md: a fresh checkout (this scheduled-routine sandbox) never ran scripts/setup_dev_env.sh, so node_modules/@agentv/core was absent and evaluate_model.py --ship-gates crashed before producing a scoreboard for either arm. The prior fix (npm ci with sanitized NODE_OPTIONS) already existed for a human running setup_dev_env.sh, but scripts/run_autotrain_continuous.py itself had no self-heal path and would repeat this failure on every fresh checkout invoked by the continuous driver directly (e.g. a scheduled routine that never calls the human bootstrap script).
harness_repair.fix_summary: Added scripts/run_autotrain_continuous.py:_ensure_agentv_sdk(), called at the start of run_cycle before experiments run. It checks node_modules/@agentv/core/package.json across checkout_roots() and, if missing, self-heals by running `npm ci` with slm_training.bridge_utils.sanitized_node_env() (the same fix scripts/setup_dev_env.sh applies for humans), failing closed with a clear SELF_HEAL_AGENTV_SDK_FAILED error if npm ci itself fails.

next_action: retry_measurement: replay the identical frozen c2 control/canvas arms now that the AgentV SDK self-heal is in place
